sources.entry: SpotAsk - Native macOS menu bar AI assistant for quick questions: ask first, then use your own AI service for an in-app answer or send the question to another AI, app, or terminal command. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/shiquda/SpotAsk)

summary.one_liner: SpotAsk is a native macOS menu-bar AI assistant that summons with a hotkey to answer questions with your own API key or route them to web AI, desktop apps, or local CLI agents.
summary.what_it_does: SpotAsk runs from the macOS menu bar and opens a focused question window with the global hotkey Option+Space. Answers stream from your own OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or Gemini endpoint, using a key stored in the macOS Keychain. External Ask sends a question to web AI services such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Grok, to desktop apps via custom URI schemes, or to local CLI agents like omp in Terminal. A decision model (System One or OpenAI Decisions) can recommend a destination with a confidence score, or auto-send above a threshold. A selection assistant shows an action bar for highlighted text in any app, offering translate, explain, summarize, polish, or send-to-chat. The app also supports image paste and file attachments, multi-turn chat, and prompt presets.
use_cases: Ask quick AI questions from anywhere on macOS
Translate, explain, or summarize highlighted text in any app
Route a question to ChatGPT, Perplexity, or another web AI
Send a question to a local CLI agent in Terminal
Use my own API key for AI chat without a subscription app
Let a decision model choose where a question should go
how_to_run: Or download the arm64 or x86_64 DMG from GitHub Releases
Open Settings (⌘ + ,), go to Services, add endpoint, model ID, and API key, then click Test Connection
notable: External Ask routes questions to web AI, desktop apps via URI schemes, or local CLI agents in one keystroke
Decision routing with a confidence score, inline confirmation, or threshold auto-send
Selection assistant works across macOS apps via an inline action bar
Pure Swift and AppKit with no Electron runtime
Zero telemetry and BYOK with keys kept in Keychain
caveats: Selection assistant needs Accessibility permission when enabled
Official releases support Spotlight, Siri, and Shortcuts; custom builds need your own Personal Team signing in Xcode
keywords: share questions with ai in terminal
